snippet.title: The Disney Afternoon Collection - Official Nintendo Switch & Physical Pre-Order Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Can you feel the buzz? Travel back to the ‘90s with characters from Disney Afternoon programming in this collection of retro Disney NES and SNES games, coming soon to Nintendo Switch and Switch 2. This Switch-exclusive update to the original 2017 collection adds two new games – Bonkers and Goof Troop – to the lineup for a total of eight games, including DuckTales 1 & 2, Chip 'n Dale Rescue Rangers 1 & 2,  TaleSpin and Darkwing Duck. This is the first time that Goof Troop and Bonkers have been released for Nintendo Switch or Nintendo Switch 2.

Pre-Order Disney Afternoon Collection: https://atari.com/products/disney-afternoon-collection
